svg.title: Which sdlc steps run on which track
svg.desc: Which sdlc steps run on which track. Columns: Trivial, S, M low risk, M high risk, L, L in parts. Rows: 36 steps in Before Define, Define, Build, Review and Ship with Learn. A filled square always runs, a square with a dot runs only when its condition holds (a bug, UI work, a security-touched diff, a review finding), an empty square doesn't run. Always-run counts: Trivial 4, S 15, M low risk 16, M high risk 21, L 18, L in parts 20. Conditional counts: 0, 10, 14, 10, 15, 15. Sizing picks the track by how many files the change touches. Steps are listed in docs/track-matrix.md.
svg.text: Size and risk, one line (a lookup)
Read the brief and the code
Setup check, feature name and paths
Ask until clear, one question at a time
Bug: failing test and root cause
UI mapping against the design system
Stop: you approve the change file
Per part: plan, verify, commit, handoff
Review decision from the fixed table
Fix round, then one closing check
Stop: PR open, merge on your word
